payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans diffs, tracks min sum of consecutive diff pairs (simulating merged gap from removal) and overall max diff, then returns the larger of the two.
payload.rationale: The code enumerates all possible hold removals indirectly by considering each consecutive diff pair, performing a complete search over the n-2 options. Though it doesn't use recursion, it fits brute-force enumeration, closest to backtracking among the given limited subtypes.
